mapper.update: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS cage_event_log ( id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, scan_batch_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, event_type VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, cage_box_qr_code VARCHAR(64), prev_shelve_id VARCHAR(64), prev_position VARCHAR(16), prev_campus_name VARCHAR(64), prev_room_name VARCHAR(64), curr_shelve_id VARCHAR(64), curr_position VARCHAR(16), curr_campus_name VARCHAR(64), curr_room_name VARCHAR(64), prev_value_json TEXT, curr_value_json TEXT, detail_summary VARCHAR(512), pi_name VARCHAR(64), project_pi_name VARCHAR(64), department_name VARCHAR(128), changed_at DATETIME NOT NULL, INDEX idx_box (cage_box_qr_code), INDEX idx_batch (scan_batch_id), INDEX idx_type (event_type, changed_at), INDEX idx_pos_curr (curr_shelve_id, curr_position), INDEX idx_pos_prev (prev_shelve_id, prev_position), INDEX idx_pi (project_pi_name), INDEX idx_time (changed_at), INDEX idx_campus (curr_campus_name) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cage_event_log ( scan_batch_id, event_type, cage_box_qr_code, prev_shelve_id, prev_position, prev_campus_name, prev_room_name, curr_shelve_id, curr_position, curr_campus_name, curr_room_name, prev_value_json, curr_value_json, detail_summary, pi_name, project_pi_name, department_name, changed_at ) VALUES ( #{scanBatchId}, #{eventType}, #{cageBoxQrCode}, #{prevShelveId}, #{prevPosition}, #{prevCampusName}, #{prevRoomName}, #{currShelveId}, #{currPosition}, #{currCampusName}, #{currRoomName}, #{prevValueJson}, #{currValueJson}, #{detailSummary}, #{piName}, #{projectPiName}, #{departmentName}, #{changedAt} )

( #{e.scanBatchId}, #{e.eventType}, #{e.cageBoxQrCode}, #{e.prevShelveId}, #{e.prevPosition}, #{e.prevCampusName}, #{e.prevRoomName}, #{e.currShelveId}, #{e.currPosition}, #{e.currCampusName}, #{e.currRoomName}, #{e.prevValueJson}, #{e.currValueJson}, #{e.detailSummary}, #{e.piName}, #{e.projectPiName}, #{e.departmentName}, #{e.changedAt} )
mapper.select:
SELECT * FROM cage_event_log WHERE event_type = 'STATUS_ADDED' AND (
detail_summary LIKE CONCAT('新增 «', #{code}, '» %')
)
AND scan_batch_id = #{scanBatchId}
AND changed_at <= DATE_SUB(#{referenceTime}, INTERVAL #{delayDays} DAY)
AND changed_at <= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{delayDays} DAY)
ORDER BY changed_at DESC
